summary: Human Resources Professional with 8 years of experience in human resources and recruiting. Expertise in Employee Relations and Recruiting. Highly driven to achieve company goals.

experience.title: Senior HR Business Partner
responsibilities: Organized startup of a new call center and recruited, hired, and onboarded over 1,000 employees.
Administered HR activities, ensuring compliance with laws, regulations, policies, and procedures.
Performed benefits, compensation, recruiting, professional development, and employee relations functions.
Acted as liaison between employees and headquarters.
Prepared Personnel Action Notices and entered data into PeopleSoft.
Designed queries and prepared reports for management.
Facilitated new hire orientation sessions and maintained current knowledge of HR procedures and labor laws.

experience.title: HR & Safety Manager
responsibilities: Created HR policies and procedures; recruited employees; developed orientation, training, and incentive programs.
Managed leave-of-absence programs and personnel records; administered benefits enrollment.
Reorganized Waynesboro complex and established HR principles.
Structured training, compensation, benefits, incentives, and new‑employee orientation programs.
Fostered a teamwork/open‑door environment across the organization.
Managed workers' compensation program for four locations and trained managers on injury procedures.
Wrote trainings on disciplinary procedures, code of conduct, FMLA, attendance, and benefits.
Implemented I9 and eVerify procedures; ensured DOT, OSHA, and DEQ compliance.
Conducted pre‑employment, post‑accident, and random drug screens; managed staff reductions and disciplinary actions.

experience.title: HR Supervisor
responsibilities: Managed broad HR functions including training, benefits administration, disciplinary action, and HR records.
Trained managers on interviewing techniques and best practices; conducted workshops and coaching sessions.
Projected daily staffing needs and managed hourly cleaning staff and HR/safety clerks.
Managed new‑hire orientation program, including HR information and company resources.
